sectors.name: Għar Ħasan
sectors.description: Placeholder sector description. Two or three sentences on the character of the rock, the style of climbing, and any history worth knowing. Globigerina limestone with pockets and rounded breaks; steep near the cave mouth, slabbier as you walk east. Dries fast after rain but goes greasy in the afternoon sun from May onwards.
sectors.approach: Placeholder approach notes. From the parking area, follow the track south past the chapel for roughly 300m, then drop left down the stepped path towards the cave mouth. Ten to twelve minutes at a walk. The last thirty metres are loose — go one at a time if there is a group.
sectors.parking: Placeholder parking notes. Room for six or seven cars on the gravel pull-in at the end of the surfaced road. Do not block the farm gate. No shade, no facilities, nearest water is in Birżebbuġa.

boulders.name: The Cave Block
boulders.description: Placeholder boulder description. The obvious detached block sitting left of the cave mouth, taking the morning shade. Flat landing on the front face, sloping and awkward round the back.

topo.alt: Topo of The Cave Block showing four numbered lines on the front face

climbs.name: Sirocco
climbs.description: Placeholder climb description. Start matched on the low rail, pull through the roof on two pockets and finish up the arête. The heel beta is worth the effort.

photos.alt: Climber pulling through the roof on Sirocco
Climber matching the finishing jug on Sirocco

climbs.name: Salt Line
climbs.description: Placeholder climb description. Straight up the centre of the face on flat edges. Reachy through the middle.

climbs.name: Back Pocket
climbs.description: Placeholder climb description. The sit start into Salt Line via the undercut. Bring a second pad for the sloping landing.

boulders.name: Sea Wall
boulders.description: Placeholder boulder description. The long wall running towards the water, split by an obvious crack. Best in the last two hours of light. Check the tide before committing to the low starts.

topo.alt: Topo of Sea Wall showing five numbered lines from left to right

climbs.name: Low Tide
climbs.description: Placeholder climb description. The left-hand line on big holds. A good first problem of the day.

climbs.name: Grigal
climbs.description: Placeholder climb description. Powerful moves off the low crimps into a long pull for the break, then easy ground.

photos.alt: Climber setting up for the long pull on Grigal

climbs.name: Xlokk
climbs.description: Placeholder climb description. The hardest thing on the wall. Two hard moves off the ground, then a committing slap to the rounded top.

climbs.name: Salt Line
climbs.description: Placeholder climb description. Shares a name with the problem on The Cave Block, hence the explicit slug. Right-hand finish on poor slopers.

boulders.name: The Terrace
boulders.description: Placeholder boulder description. Flat platform above the main path with two short problems and a good warm-up traverse. Shade all afternoon.

topo.alt: Topo of The Terrace showing two numbered lines and the traverse

climbs.name: Warm-Up Traverse
climbs.description: Placeholder climb description. Left to right along the break. Feet stay low.
